name: devloop
description: TypeScript dev-loop runtime with shared Board and policy: git/PR (GitHub + GitLab), workspace/repo context, lint/test gates, and thin Codex hooks.

interface.longDescription: Bundles developer workflow skills for controlled Git/PR operations, validation, review, and shared PR/MR reconciliation tasks. Native lifecycle hooks include SessionEnd cleanup and execution guardrails; Codex Scheduled tasks can invoke the same task definition used by Claude monitors.
